question: How much does a UK Electronic Travel Authorisation (ETA) cost to apply for?
answer: A UK ETA costs £20 to apply for, according to GOV.UK (page dated 22 October 2026) [1]. The Home Office's April 2026 factsheet also says it currently costs £20 and notes the fee is kept under review [5]. That factsheet also says an ETA permits multiple journeys of up to six months at a time over two years, or until the holder's passport expires, whichever is sooner [5]. Other websites may charge more, so apply only through GOV.UK or the official UK ETA app [1][3]. The ETA fee is not refundable if you cancel the application [7].

keyPoints.text: An ETA costs £20 when applied for through the official government service.
Other websites or application services may charge more than the UK Government fee, so applicants should avoid imitation sites.
Applicants should use the official UK ETA app or GOV.UK to apply and avoid scam sites.
The ETA fee is kept under review by the Home Office, so the amount could change.

mayBeStale.text: Source 5 is an April 2026 factsheet and source 3 is dated February 2026; the £20 figure should be confirmed on GOV.UK, as fees are reviewed.
Source 2 lists UK visa fees and notes an ETA fee change dated October 2023, but does not state the current ETA amount.
